caution_findings.evidence_context: DRAMP labels EK1-C16 with a broad Antimicrobial/Antiviral category and duplicates the same entry across source tables; primary local evidence supports antiviral coronavirus activity, so the database rows remain source_conflict with matched activity IDs.

The source reports EK1-C16 as a core peptide plus GSGSG-PEG4-C16. DRAMP stores the peptide-chain sequence and C-terminal modification separately; final curation preserves both fields without silent normalization.

The paper text supports qualitative SARS-CoV-2 WT authentic inhibition, D614G fusion suppression, VSV-G specificity, and RD-cell cytotoxicity context. Exact figure-only curve values beyond stated IC50/concentration values were not fabricated.

Packet/source supplementary directories and supplementary index/table artifacts were checked and contain no supplementary files or tables; this is nonblocking because all reported EK1-C16 values needed for the gate are in local XML/PDF text.
Worker-6 accepts direct fusion/entry inhibition evidence but keeps C16 membrane/endosome rationale as putative context, not as directly quantified binding/localization evidence.
